_doc: Hand labels of asset animations, to score the motion critic. 'good' = the joints are the real object's and move as it does, nothing comes apart; 'bad' = something a reviewer would reject. Labels are of the articulation, so they hold across re-renders until the asset is re-drafted (then re-label). Labelled from the contact sheets and critic frames on the dates given. Relabelled 2026-10-06 from close-ups: two 'good' labels had judged only the joints that existed.

pipe_wrench_gap_tool_assignment.label: good
pipe_wrench_gap_tool_assignment.why: handles open and close about the pivot

industrial_grinding_machine.label: bad
industrial_grinding_machine.why: the grinding wheels never spin; only the eye shields move

keurigk_minisingleservecoffeemaker_3.label: bad
keurigk_minisingleservecoffeemaker_3.why: only the lid's outer rim loop lifts; the lid top stays down (the real handle and lid rise as one); the brew button does not press

compact_multimeter_lowpoly.label: bad
compact_multimeter_lowpoly.why: the test probes hover in mid-air the whole run (cables held rigid)

floor_lamp.label: bad
floor_lamp.why: nothing visibly moves; the head should tilt

upright_dyson_vacuum_cleaner.label: bad
upright_dyson_vacuum_cleaner.why: a part flips off the handle mid-run

bmx.label: bad
bmx.why: only the seat post moves; wheels, fork and cranks fixed; grips come apart

bmx_1.label: bad
bmx_1.why: wheels spin but nothing steers and the cranks do not turn

calipers.label: bad
calipers.why: the slider moves across the beam instead of along it
